title: Space Colonizer | Free Browser-Based Space Colonization Strategy Game
author: SilverFocus7492
selftext:
hey there i made this space colonization game in which u send rockets satellite rover and lander to first colonize the planet and gather information about it then fly a rocket yourself perform safe landing on a planet   
at first u are given few satellite, rover and lander to colonize moon and then use their resources to colonize other planets
